name: Vasto (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and white, the white charged with the municipal seal of Vasto (the arms within a yellow ring inscribed HISTONIUM OLIM ROMANUM MUNICIPIUM VASTUM).
history: Municipal flag of Vasto, a comune in Abruzzo; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.
